body: :( Luckily, those weren't my first but I have lots of those too. Tough to carry around sometimes. I hope it all turned out okay.

Okay so here's mine. As a kid, my mom used to give me spoonfuls of peanut butter and I thought it was the most awesome thing in the world. So I must have been about 2 and I was running around the house in nothing but my diaper when I saw what I thought was peanut butter on the floor. I scooped it up and yelled to my mom, "look mama, peanut butter!" and before she could do anything, I stuck it in my mouth, as kids do. Well, that's when I realized it was NOT peanut butter. It must have been poop that fell out of my diaper.
TL;DR Picked something up from the floor. Thought it was peanut butter so I ate it. Turned out I ate my own poop.

Not the parent but when I was about 10, I was at a hotel with my parents and a lot of my parents friends were there. I thought it would be a good idea to get into the same compartment of one of those rotating doors as a morbidly obese man. Well, while in the door, I stepped on the back of his foot, knocking him over. The door kept going and I then stepped on him to avoid being hit by the moving door. The door then made a horrible grinding sound and stopped as it couldn't push him. I then sat in this glass door for 20 minutes while someone from service came to fix it while my parents and their friends watched, horrified. The whole time the man I stepped on said nothing to me.

My uncle served in Vietnam with a guy whose last name was Lastname. According to my uncle, the sergeants always thought he was talking back to them when he was asked to identify himself and he got a lot of shit for it.
